places.name: Iguazú Falls (Argentinian Side, UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: The Argentinian side of the falls offers extensive trails (Upper Circuit, Lower Circuit, Devil's Throat walkway) providing close-up, immersive views of the numerous cascades within Iguazú National Park. Boat trips under the falls are a popular activity.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry usually 1.5 hours before closing; check official park website

places.best_time_to_visit: Mar–May, Sep–Nov (avoid peak summer heat/crowds and potential low water in winter)
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and rain gear/poncho (you will get wet near falls/on boats). Allow a full day. Consider boat trip ('Gran Aventura') for thrilling experience. Buy tickets online.
places.advanced_booking: Recommended (Park entry, essential for boat trips)
places.cost: Paid (National Park entrance fee + optional tours)
places.address: Parque Nacional Iguazú, Misiones Province, Argentina

places.name: Devil’s Throat (Garganta del Diablo)
places.ai_summary: The largest and most impressive section of Iguazú Falls. On the Argentinian side, accessed via a long walkway over the upper Iguazú River leading to a stunning viewpoint directly overlooking the immense chasm.

opening_hours.notes: Walkway may close due to high water levels; check status

places.place_tip: Take the free Rainforest Ecological Train within the park to Garganta Station, followed by a ~1km walk on flat metal walkways. Prepare to get wet from the spray.
places.cost: Included in National Park entrance fee
places.address: Garganta del Diablo walkway, Parque Nacional Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

places.name: Upper Circuit Trail
places.ai_summary: Easy, accessible trail (~1.7km loop) on the Argentinian side of Iguazú Falls, offering panoramic views from above the cascades. Walkways provide multiple perspectives looking down onto the falls.

opening_hours.notes: Flat, metal walkways, accessible

places.place_tip: Provides excellent overview perspectives of many falls. Combine with the Lower Circuit for different angles.
places.cost: Included in National Park entrance fee
places.address: Paseo Superior, Parque Nacional Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

places.name: Lower Circuit Trail
places.ai_summary: Trail (~1.6km loop) on the Argentinian side of Iguazú Falls offering closer views of several falls, including Bossetti and Dos Hermanas. Involves more stairs than the Upper Circuit, getting closer to the base of some cascades.

opening_hours.notes: Involves stairs

places.place_tip: Offers different perspectives and closer encounters with the falls than the Upper Circuit. Can connect to the ferry to San Martin Island (when operational).
places.cost: Included in National Park entrance fee
places.address: Paseo Inferior, Parque Nacional Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

places.name: Macuco Trail Hike
places.ai_summary: Nature trail (~7km round trip) within the Argentinian side of Iguazú National Park, leading through subtropical rainforest to the Arrechea Waterfall, where swimming is sometimes permitted. Offers wildlife spotting opportunities (monkeys, coatis, birds).

opening_hours.notes: Allow sufficient time before park closing; trail may close due to weather

places.place_tip: Less crowded than the main falls circuits. Wear comfortable shoes, bring water, insect repellent, and swimwear if planning to swim (check if permitted).
places.cost: Included in National Park entrance fee
places.address: Sendero Macuco, Parque Nacional Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

places.name: Great Adventure Boat Ride
places.ai_summary: 'Gran Aventura' is a popular boat tour on the Argentinian side that combines a jungle truck ride with a thrilling speedboat trip up the Iguazú River canyon, culminating in a drenching ride under some of the falls.

opening_hours.notes: Operated by specific concessionaire (Iguazu Jungle); check schedule/booking

places.place_tip: Book well in advance. Prepare to get completely soaked; waterproof bags provided for belongings. An intense and exciting experience.
places.address: Departure points within Parque Nacional Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

places.name: Iguazú National Park Train
places.ai_summary: Free ecological train service within the Argentinian side of Iguazú National Park. Connects the entrance area (Central Station) with Cataratas Station (access to Upper/Lower Circuits) and Garganta Station (access to Devil's Throat walkway).

opening_hours.notes: Runs frequently throughout the day

places.suggested_duration: Variable (ride time between stations is short)
places.place_tip: Convenient way to cover distances within the large park, especially to reach the Devil's Throat walkway. Can have queues during peak times.
places.cost: Included in National Park entrance fee
places.address: Stations within Parque Nacional Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

places.name: Itaipú Dam Tour (Nearby Paraguay Border)
places.ai_summary: Visit to the massive Itaipu Dam, one of the world's largest hydroelectric power plants, located on the border between Brazil and Paraguay (near Foz do Iguaçu, Brazil). Tours showcase the scale of the dam, power generation, and ecological projects.

opening_hours.notes: Requires crossing border into Brazil or Paraguay; check visa/entry requirements. Book tours via official Itaipu website.

places.place_tip: Requires passport and potentially visa depending on nationality and which side (Brazil/Paraguay) you visit from. Book tours in advance. Different tour options available (panoramic, technical).
places.address: Itaipu Binacional, Foz do Iguaçu, PR, Brazil / Hernandarias, Paraguay

places.name: Parque das Aves (Brazil Side)
places.ai_summary: Bird park located near the entrance to the Brazilian side of Iguazu Falls (Foz do Iguaçu). Features large walk-through aviaries housing numerous species of Atlantic Rainforest birds (toucans, macaws, etc.), plus reptiles and butterflies.

opening_hours.notes: Requires crossing border into Brazil; check visa/entry requirements and confirm hours

places.place_tip: Requires passport and potentially visa depending on nationality. Easily combined with a visit to the Brazilian side of the falls. Great for bird lovers and photography.
places.advanced_booking: Can buy tickets online or at entrance
places.address: Av. das Cataratas, KM 17.1, Foz do Iguaçu, PR, 85855-750, Brazil

places.name: Three Borders Landmark (Hito Tres Fronteras)
places.ai_summary: Point in Puerto Iguazú where the Iguazú and Paraná rivers meet, marking the borders of Argentina, Brazil, and Paraguay. Features monuments from each country, viewpoints, artisan stalls, and often evening light/water shows.

opening_hours.notes: Check locally for light show times (usually after sunset)

places.place_tip: Good spot for sunset views over the rivers and seeing the three countries. Easily accessible from Puerto Iguazú town.
places.address: Hito Tres Fronteras, Puerto Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

attribution.title: Argentina-Brazil border
attribution.author: seretide
attribution.description: International border between Argentina (Puerto Iguazú) and Brazil (Foz do Iguazú)

places.name: Guira Oga Wildlife Refuge
places.ai_summary: Wildlife rescue and rehabilitation center near Puerto Iguazú. Focuses on native Atlantic Rainforest fauna affected by habitat loss or trafficking. Guided tours explain their work and allow viewing of animals undergoing rehabilitation (toucans, monkeys, coatis, cats, etc.).

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours depart regularly; check website for exact times/last tour

places.place_tip: Located on RN12 just outside Puerto Iguazú. Educational experience focused on conservation. Animals are in rehabilitation enclosures, not a traditional zoo.
places.advanced_booking: Not usually required, join next available tour
places.address: RN12 KM 1638, N3370 Puerto Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

places.name: Aripuca Eco-Museum
places.ai_summary: 'La Aripuca' is an ecological theme park near Puerto Iguazú built around a giant structure resembling a traditional trap (aripuca), made from reclaimed giant trees. Aims to raise awareness about deforestation and Guarani culture. Features exhibits, local crafts, and food.

opening_hours.notes: Check website or locally for exact hours

places.place_tip: Located on RN12 just outside Puerto Iguazú. Interesting structure and message about conservation. Opportunity to try regional ice cream flavors.
places.address: RN12 km 4.5, N3370 Puerto Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

places.name: Tancredo Neves Bridge
places.ai_summary: Bridge spanning the Iguazú River, connecting Puerto Iguazú, Argentina, with Foz do Iguaçu, Brazil. Also known as the 'Fraternity Bridge'. A key border crossing point, often viewed from nearby landmarks like Hito Tres Fronteras.

opening_hours.notes: Requires border control procedures to cross

places.place_tip: You'll cross this bridge if traveling between the Argentinian and Brazilian sides of the falls by road. Can be viewed from Hito Tres Fronteras.
places.cost: Free (to view); Tolls/transport costs to cross
places.address: Puente Internacional Tancredo Neves, RN12, Puerto Iguazú / BR-469, Foz do Iguaçu

places.name: Iguazú Jungle Tours
places.ai_summary: Company offering adventure activities within Iguazú National Park (Argentinian side), most famously the 'Gran Aventura' boat ride under the falls, but also potentially 4x4 jungle rides ('Paseo Ecológico') focusing on flora and fauna.

opening_hours.notes: Check website for specific tour schedules and booking

places.place_tip: Book 'Gran Aventura' well in advance. 'Paseo Ecológico' offers a calmer alternative focused on the rainforest environment.
places.address: Offices/Departure points within Parque Nacional Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

places.name: La Lorenza Nature Reserve
places.ai_summary: Private nature reserve near Puerto Iguazú offering guided walks through the Atlantic Rainforest, focusing on native flora, fauna, and birdwatching. Also offers kayaking on the Paraná River.

opening_hours.notes: Check website or contact for tour availability and booking

places.place_tip: Offers a more intimate rainforest experience away from the main falls area. Good for birdwatching and learning about the local ecosystem.
places.address: Puerto Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina (specific location confirmed on booking)

places.name: Helicopter Flight Over Falls (Brazil Side)
places.ai_summary: Helicopter tours offering aerial views of Iguazú Falls, departing from Foz do Iguaçu on the Brazilian side. Provides a unique perspective of the scale and layout of the falls and surrounding rainforest.

opening_hours.notes: Requires crossing border into Brazil; check visa/entry requirements. Book with operator (e.g., Helisul).

places.place_tip: Requires passport and potentially visa. Controversial due to noise impact on wildlife; flights do not go directly over the park center. Provides unparalleled overview.
places.address: Helisul Taxi Aéreo, Av. das Cataratas, Foz do Iguaçu, PR, Brazil

places.name: San Ignacio Mini Jesuit Ruins
places.ai_summary: Well-preserved ruins of a 17th-century Jesuit mission, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Located approx. 240km south of Puerto Iguazú. Features impressive red sandstone church facade, living quarters, and central plaza. Offers insight into the Jesuit missions in the region.

opening_hours.notes: Check official hours; evening light/sound show often available

places.place_tip: Requires a long day trip or overnight stay from Puerto Iguazú. Consider combining with Wanda Mines. Guided tours available on site.
places.address: San Ignacio Miní, Misiones Province, Argentina

places.name: Puerto Iguazú Artisan Market
places.ai_summary: Small market area often located near the Hito Tres Fronteras or central areas in Puerto Iguazú, selling local crafts, Guarani artwork, souvenirs, yerba mate gourds, and other handmade goods.

opening_hours.notes: Stall hours can be irregular, often busiest in evenings/weekends

places.place_tip: Good spot for picking up local Guarani crafts and souvenirs. Compare prices. Often near Hito Tres Fronteras.
places.address: Near Hito Tres Fronteras or central areas, Puerto Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

places.name: Selva Iryapú Lodge Trail
places.ai_summary: Refers to trails within the 'Selva Iryapú' jungle reserve area, where many eco-lodges are located, just outside Puerto Iguazú town. Offers opportunities for walking through the rainforest, birdwatching, and experiencing the native environment.

opening_hours.notes: Check with lodges for guided walk options/access

places.place_tip: If staying in the area, ask your lodge about nearby trails. Otherwise, consider guided walks for safety and interpretation. Use insect repellent.
places.address: Selva Iryapú, Puerto Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina

places.name: Birdwatching Walks in the Rainforest
places.ai_summary: Iguazú National Park and the surrounding Atlantic Rainforest are exceptionally rich in birdlife (toucans, trogons, tanagers, etc.). Guided birdwatching walks offer the best chance to spot and identify numerous species.

opening_hours.notes: Book with specialized guides/operators

places.place_tip: Book with experienced local bird guides for best results. Bring binoculars and insect repellent. Be patient and quiet on the trails.
places.address: Various locations in/around Parque Nacional Iguazú, Misiones, Argentina
places.name_native: Observación de Aves en la Selva
